iti40:1.1: II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti40:2.1: Avijjā bhikkhave pubbaṅgamā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā, anvad-eva ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ. Vijjā ca kho bhikkhave pubbaṅgamā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā, anvad-eva hirottappan-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti40:3.1: Yā kāci-mā duggatiyo asmiṃ loke paramhi ca | avijjāmūlakā sabbā icchālobhasamussayā ||
iti40:4.1: Yato ca hoti pāpiccho ahirīko anādaro | tato pāpaṃ pasavati apāyaṃ tena gacchati ||
iti40:5.1: Tasmā chandañca lobhañca avijjañca virājayaṃ | vijjaṃ uppādayaṃ bhikkhu sabbā duggatiyo jahe ti ||
iti40:6.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||3|| Paṭhamabhāṇavāraṃ.
